name: Heart Strings
source:
Bored of your job, you become invested in a widely popular book series as an escape. You find yourself at  a book signing for your beloved series where you meet four strangers, could this lead to a budding friendship or something more...?

[from [url=https://madizzy.itch.io/heart-strings]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
厌倦工作的你，沉迷于一套极受欢迎的丛书，借此逃离现实。在心爱系列的签售会上，你遇见了四个陌生人。这会成为友谊的萌芽，还是更进一步…？

[摘自[url=https://madizzy.itch.io/heart-strings]itch.io[/url]]
